entry.title: πToniC 1.0.1
entry.summary: # πToniC 1.0.1 Add a SAMPLE source to each of the eight percussion voices. - Switch each voice between SYNTH and SAMPLE. - Load mono/stereo WAV files up to ten seconds: PCM 16/24/32-bit or float32, 8–192 kHz. - TUNE adjusts playback pitch; START chooses the start position. Envelopes, pitch modulation, noise, character processing and effect sends remain available. - Contextual TONE Q-Links change from FREQUENCY / WAVE MORPH to TUNE / START. - Background sample loading and cached positive/negative

entry.title: πToniC 1.0.0
entry.summary: # πToniC 1.0.0 Eight-voice percussion synthesis with native MPC sequencing, touch controls and shared stereo effects. - Oscillator morphing, filtered noise, amplitude and pitch envelopes, sine/random pitch modulation. - Per-voice drive, EQ, velocity response, pan and choke groups. - A/B comparison, ALTER and RAND VOICE. - Shared reverb and synchronised/free delay, with two sends per voice. - Five touch pages, contextual Q-Links and azure trigger activity. - 150 converted Patternarium BEST kits i
